meta.title: ANATOMICA lymphatic system geometry resolution — Milestone 13
meta.paths: mesh paths are relative to the project root; meshes are the extracted BP3D 4.0 working copies under work/bp3d/ (sources in data/sources/ stay byte-identical)
meta.units: source coordinates are millimetres (OBJ headers; verified in Milestone 2)
meta.counting: vertices = lines starting 'v ', faces = lines starting 'f ', counted by streaming each file; bbox measured from the same vertex stream
